Occupied slots, active units, owned conflict paths and seen IDs use membership sets. Their bool values are observations, not control modes or external permission.

The owned checkout directory handle closes after bounded tools finish. Tool IO, scope and process errors remain authoritative.
The executable handle is read-only; mode, symlink identity, content hash and read failures are returned before closing.
